text:
Claire (CS): dropping a compact 'go-live lite' runbook for low-touch customers. Goal: safe activation, minimal ops, clear AE copy. thoughts?
Diego (SRE): include exact alert thresholds and a one-click disable for scheduled prefill. Ops prefers two alerts: error-rate and token-surge.
Mina (Eng): tech knobs to call out: prefix cache TTL=25m, micro-cache entries=3, batching latency target=60ms p95, streaming chunk <=256 tokens. fallback to single-request path on repeated chunk errors.
Claire (CS): runbook checklist (short): 1) Softstart window 0-48h. 2) Micro-prefill: 3 probe requests spaced 2m apart. 3) Streaming ON with fallback rule. 4) Monitor: sessions, token burn, 5xx. 5) Renewal-risk flag if engagement drops one tier in 7d or token burn >2x + errors.
Hiro (AE): can we get a one-liner for kickoff email? propose: "We'll run a 48h softstart with a small pre-warm and streaming enabled to improve responsiveness; we'll check in after 48h."
Lena (Enablement): I'll draft AE one-pager and include FAQ answers: "Will prefill increase my bill?" and "When does streaming get disabled?" Short answers only.
Diego (SRE): alert definitions: A) Error surge: 5xx > 1% sustained 3m. B) Token surge: tokens/min > baseline*1.8 for 5m. Remediation: flip prefill off, reduce batch size, notify AE+CS, open ticket. warmup-bot will create ticket after 3 prefill failures.
warmup-bot: Warmup ticket created: WM-8112; assignee: SRE-oncall.
Mina (Eng): add engineering note: autoscaler respects committed caps; capacity bump is manual and for critical go-lives only. For streaming perceived latency, prefer incremental chunks to retries.
Claire (CS): next steps: Lena to produce AE copy EOD, Mina to confirm TTLs, Diego to codify alerts and disable switch. We'll pilot with two low-touch accounts this week and capture a 48h survey (latency ok Y/N; output meets expectations Y/N; any blockers Y/N).
